basis_note: All figures consolidated (Group) basis — Southeast Bank's multi-year summary tables are prepared on that basis; see quarterly/*.json period_note.

provision_coverage_pct.note: Provision for Classified Loans as % of Classified Loans (specific-provision coverage of NPLs).

gross_npl_coverage_pct.note: Provision for Classified plus Unclassified Loans as % of Classified Loans (total loan-loss provision cover of NPLs).

roa_pct_period_end.note: Recomputed from period-end balances for cross-bank comparability; the bank's own reported ROA uses average balances, so the two differ.

roe_pct_period_end.note: Recomputed from period-end balances for cross-bank comparability; the bank's own reported ROE uses average balances, so the two differ.

capital_surplus_pct.note: Reported Capital Surplus/(Deficit) as % of required capital, where required capital is derived as Total Capital minus the reported surplus. Negative values are a capital shortfall against the Basel requirement.

net_interest_margin_proxy_pct.note: Net interest income as % of period-end interest-earning assets. A proxy for NIM: the bank does not report NIM directly and this uses period-end, not average, earning assets.

price_to_book.note: Year-end DSE market price divided by net asset value per share.
